scripts.dev: npm run build -w @aq/contracts && concurrently -k -n contracts,api,web "npm run dev -w @aq/contracts" "npm run dev -w @aq/api" "npm run dev -w @aq/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @aq/contracts && tsc --noEmit -p apps/api && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.tools.json
scripts.test:db: npm run build -w @aq/contracts && vitest run --config vitest.db.config.ts
scripts.build: npm run build -w @aq/contracts && npm run build -w @aq/api && npm run build -w @aq/web
scripts.snapshots:import: npm run build -w @aq/contracts && node --import tsx scripts/import-snapshot.ts
scripts.provider:airnow:smoke: npm run build -w @aq/contracts && node --import tsx scripts/airnow-smoke.ts
scripts.db:status: npm run build -w @aq/contracts && node --import tsx scripts/db-status.ts
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build -w @aq/contracts && node --import tsx scripts/db-migrate.ts
scripts.db:seed:historical-case: npm run build -w @aq/contracts && node --import tsx scripts/seed-historical-case.ts
scripts.db:seed:sample: npm run build -w @aq/contracts && node --import tsx scripts/seed-sample.ts
scripts.research:smoke: npm run build -w @aq/contracts && node --import tsx scripts/research-smoke.ts
scripts.corpus:build: npm run build -w @aq/contracts && node --import tsx scripts/corpus.ts --build
scripts.corpus:check: npm run build -w @aq/contracts && node --import tsx scripts/corpus.ts --check
scripts.corpus:fetch: npm run build -w @aq/contracts && node --import tsx scripts/corpus.ts --fetch
scripts.retrieval:eval: npm run build -w @aq/contracts && node --import tsx scripts/retrieval-eval.ts
